current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
(a) There must be a placard in clear view of the pilot stating –
  (1) That the aeroplane must be operated in accordance with the Aeroplane Flight Manual; and
  (2) The certification category of the aeroplane to which the placards apply.
(b) For aeroplanes certificated in more than one category, there must be a placard in clear view of the pilot, stating that other limitations are contained in the Aeroplane Flight Manual.
(c) There must be a placard in clear view of the pilot that specifies the kind of operations to which the operation of the aeroplane is limited or from which it is prohibited under CS 23.1525.
